bio_md:
# 清高宗弘历(乾隆) · 主要事迹

爱新觉罗弘历（1711—1799），[[qing-shi-zong-y|世宗]]第四子，雍正十三年（1735）即位，改元乾隆。

乾隆朝六十年（后禅位三年），为清之极盛：十全武功——平准部、平回部、定大小金川、降缅甸、安南、廓尔喀等（皆遣将，帝未亲征），新疆底定，版图极于今世；又开四库全书馆，集古今之书，然寓禁于征，毁书亦夥。六下江南、南巡北狩，耗帑甚巨；晚年宠和珅，吏治渐弛。

嘉庆元年（1796）内禅[[qing-ren-zong|仁宗]]，自称太上皇，训政三年；嘉庆四年（1799）崩。盛世之极，亦即衰象之萌——鸦片之芽已在乾隆晚年种下。

bio_parts_en.value: Aisin Gioro Hongli (1711-1799), fourth son of

, took the throne in 1735, era Qianlong.

His sixty years (plus three as retired emperor) were the summit of Qing power: the Ten Complete Campaigns - the Zunghars and the Muslim cities pacified, Jinchuan, Burma, Vietnam, the Gurkhas - all by generals, never in person - brought the map to its greatest extent; the Four Treasuries gathered all letters, though with censorship built in and many books destroyed. Six southern tours and lavish circuits drained the treasury; in his old age Heshen rose and officialdom rotted.

In 1796 he abdicated to
and reigned on as retired emperor, dying in 1799. The zenith of the splendor was also the seedbed of decline - the opium habit was already planted.
